valid_overwrite_bits.name: valid_overwrite_bits
valid_overwrite_bits.value: "channel_overwrites"."allow_bits" between 0 and 16383 and "channel_overwrites"."deny_bits" between 0 and 16383 and ("channel_overwrites"."allow_bits" & "channel_overwrites"."deny_bits") = 0

valid_conversation.name: valid_conversation
valid_conversation.value: ("conversations"."channel_id" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_low" is null and "conversations"."dm_user_high" is null) or ("conversations"."channel_id" is null and "conversations"."dm_user_low" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_high" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_low" < "conversations"."dm_user_high")

valid_message.name: valid_message
valid_message.value: "messages"."seq" > 0 and "messages"."version" > 0 and char_length("messages"."body") <= 2000 and ("messages"."deleted_at" is null or "messages"."body" = '')
